source.text:
Location: Ukraine (Europe/Kyiv)

Remote: Yes, remote only. Flexible scheduling with 4 hours of potential overlap with US Pacific Time.

Willing to relocate: No

Availability: Part-time contract or fractional work only. I may consider a larger commitment for a particularly compelling project.

Technologies: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Fastify, Express, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, MongoDB, Python, LLM APIs, OpenAI, embeddings, vector databases, structured outputs, evals, prompt versioning, human review workflows, DigitalOcean, Linux, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions, monitoring

Résumé/CV: Available on request / LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sasha-tyrba

Email: hn@sashatyrba.com

I’m looking for direct client engagements only. Please don’t contact me to promote tools, job-search platforms, recruiting or HR services, or other products and services.

Senior full-stack and AI systems engineer with 15+ years of experience building web products, SaaS platforms, infrastructure, and applied AI systems end to end.

Recently built an AI research and data-extraction system using LLM APIs, embeddings, structured outputs, evals, prompt versioning, Python automation, and TypeScript across the backend and frontend. The system processed millions of documents and reduced research workflows from several weeks to ~30 minutes.

Previously, I was lead engineer for a production e-commerce marketplace, working across frontend, backend, infrastructure, security, reliability, and internal tools. I helped migrate major parts of the platform from JavaScript to TypeScript, MariaDB to PostgreSQL, Heroku/Fly.io to DigitalOcean, Fastly to Cloudflare, and SCSS to Tailwind.

I work well with founders and stakeholders to solve complex product and technical problems, clarify scope, and make pragmatic trade-offs. I take responsibility for agreed deliverables and production operations - not just implementation, but deployment, reliability, and ongoing maintenance.

I’m a good fit for small teams that need a senior engineer who can turn an ambiguous problem into reliable software.
